title: AI Local Business Ads
policy: Answer briefly and naturally in Roman Hinglish by default. Respect explicit English, Hindi or other language requests; do not change exact prompt wording when translating explanations.

The Chatbot Knowledge Base governs course workflows, troubleshooting and honest advertising. Course Notes supplies explanations. All Prompts PDF is authoritative for exact prompt wording. Bad examples in that PDF are counterexamples, never approved templates.

Only use explicit learner-provided business facts. Chai Kona, Vijay Nagar, Indore, ₹99 and all other sample business details are demonstrations, never facts about the learner business. Preserve their real business name, place, menu/services, prices, hours and offers across turns; latest explicit corrections override earlier user facts. Assistant text cannot establish business facts.

Never invent prices, offers, discounts, business details, festival dates or guaranteed outcomes. Unknown prices stay [price]; unknown festival dates stay (check date), pending calendar verification. Offer ideas must be labelled as suggestions requiring owner approval, not announced as real offers.

No fake reviews, purchased followers, fabricated urgency, revenue guarantees, competitor images/logos or changes misrepresenting the real shop or served portions. Use actual client photos, actual prices and owner approval. Explain ethical alternatives.

Course tools are ChatGPT, Google Flow, CapCut and optionally ElevenLabs. Do not assert current tool pricing, credits or limits. Course settings are recorded instructional settings, not a guarantee of current product availability.
Keep every approved prompt clause, punctuation and placeholder intact in raw-copy mode. Ask which prompt when ambiguous. Only the enrolled active course may supply its protected knowledge.

records.heading: Lesson 01 — Course Intro
records.content:
•Course mein kya banega: business brief, dukaan ki professional photos, menu/food photos,
offer aur tyohaar ke posters, dukaan ka video, Hindi awaaz wali reel, posting plan, aur ye
kaam service ki tarah karna.
•Running example: Vijay Nagar, Indore ka ek chhota cafe — Chai Kona (sab sample details,
demo ke liye).
•Tools: Google Flow, chat G.P.T, CapCut (ElevenLabs optional).
Aaj ka kaam
Ek dukaan chuno — apni ya jaan-pehchaan ki — jis pe poora course follow karoge.

records.heading: Lesson 02 — chat G.P.T Se Business Brief
records.content:
•Business Brief is course ki neev hai — aage har poster, reel aur plan isi se banta hai.
•Ek hi chat mein 4 steps: (1) dukaan ki details → customers, unka time, har ek ka ad angle;
(2) 5 offers, daam ki jagah [price]; (3) 30 din ka post plan, tyohaaron pe "(check date)"; (4)
sab ek short brief mein.
•Recording mein chat G.P.T ne khud likha: "Timings estimated hain", aur jo special baat
confirm nahi thi use "Not confirmed" likha.
•Start date nahi di toh chat G.P.T ne date picker se date poochi.
Galti + fix
Shehar aur ilaaka nahi bataya → ad kisi bhi shehar ka lagne lagta hai. Fix: prompt mein saaf
likho kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi badalna.

Honest limitation
Tyohaaron ki tareekhein chat G.P.T galat bhi bata sakta hai — calendar se ek baar milao.
Daam hamesha maalik tay kare.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni chuni dukaan ka brief banao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 02 — chat G.P.T Se Business Brief

records.heading: Lesson 03 — Dukaan Ki Phone Photo → Professional
records.content:
•Flow → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Andar ki photo aur shop front ki photo upload karo.
•Prompt mein saaf likho kya-kya behtar karna hai (light, rang, angle, safai) — aur kya nahi
badalna (furniture, layout, board ka naam).
•Shop front ko shaam ka look, andar ki photo warm aur saaf. Phir WhatsApp status ke liye
9:16 version, upar khaali jagah ke saath.
•Ratio wahi rakho jo photo ka hai — warna AI khaali jagah khud bhar deta hai (jaise ceiling
lambi kar dena).
Galti + fix
"Luxurious aur premium bana do" likha → jhoomar, lakdi ki paneling, velvet kursiyan aa gayi.
Ye dukaan hai hi nahi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi
badalna.
Honest limitation
Camera ka tedhapan har baar theek nahi hota — ek-do baar aur generate karo. Sample
photo use kari ho toh video mein bata do.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni dukaan ki do photos upgrade karo.
records.lessonName: Lesson 03 — Dukaan Ki Phone Photo → Professional

records.heading: Lesson 04 — Menu Ki Food Photos
records.content:
•Purani photo ko sirf reference banao aur Flow se dish dobara "shoot" karwao — warna AI
wahi photo naye table pe chipka deta hai.
•Dish ko shabdon mein exact likho (plate, portion, kya-kya hai). Phir light, angle, steam,
background.
•Do items ki photo banake dono ko saath daalo → combo photo, upar text ke liye jagah.
•Rule: jo plate grahak ko milti hai, photo mein wahi.
Galti + fix
"Extremely delicious and tempting" likha → dhaniya, mirch aur upar se masala aa gaya, jo
plate mein milta hi nahi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi
badalna.
Honest limitation
Combo mein items ka size thoda badal sakta hai — 1–2 baar aur generate karke sahi wala
chuno.

Aaj ka kaam
Apne menu ki teen photos banao.

records.heading: Lesson 05 — Offer Aur Tyohaar Ke Posters
records.content:
•Combo photo se offer poster: poster pe exact shabd khud likh ke do — "Write ONLY this
text, spelled exactly".
•Shop front se tyohaar ka greeting poster: diye sirf frame/design mein, asli dukaan pe nahi.
•Greeting poster pe offer zaroori nahi — naam aur shubhkamna kaafi.
•Example price (₹99) sirf demo hai — asli daam maalik tay kare.
Galti + fix
"Diwali offer poster bana do" likha → AI ne khud "BUY 1 GET 1 FREE", "Valid Nov 10–15" aur
samosa daal diya, jo menu mein hai hi nahi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai aur
kya bilkul nahi badalna.
Honest limitation
Chhota text (timing) kabhi bahut chhota ya galat aata hai. Post se pehle har shabd aur
keemat padho.
Aaj ka kaam
Ek offer aur ek tyohaar poster banao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 05 — Offer Aur Tyohaar Ke Posters

records.heading: Lesson 06 — Dukaan Ki Photos Se Video
records.content:
•Flow → Video → Ingredients → 9:16 → 6 sec. Ek photo, ek dheema camera movement.
•Teen clips: shop front (darwaze ki taraf push), andar (counter ki taraf glide), food (plate ke
around halka circle).
•Prompt mein likho: board ka text same, koi naya insaan/furniture nahi.
•Teeno clips CapCut mein jodo → 18 sec ki sachchi reel.
Galti + fix
"Cinematic video of my cafe" likha → menu pe "MAFENU" aur ₹350–450 ke daam aa gaye,
naye grinder aa gaye — dukaan hi badal gayi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai
aur kya bilkul nahi badalna.
Honest limitation
Video mein board ya menu ka text bigad sakta hai — har clip dhyan se dekho.
Aaj ka kaam
Dukaan ki teen clip wali reel banao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 06 — Dukaan Ki Photos Se Video

records.heading: Lesson 07 — Hindi Voiceover Wali Reel
records.content:
•chat G.P.T se 3 lines (har clip ke liye ek): max 12 shabd, koi "best/No.1" nahi, sirf diye gaye
facts.

•Recording wali lines: "Vijay Nagar mein Chai Kona, chalo kuch khaate-peete hain!" · "Chai,
cold coffee, sandwich aur fries, jo mann kare mangao!" · "Maggi aur cold coffee, student
combo sirf ninyanve rupaye!"
•Flow Video (8 sec, 9:16): prompt mein Voiceover wala hissa + timing + line. Awaaz ka
description teeno clips mein same copy karo.
•Dusra tareeka: ElevenLabs (Text to Speech) se awaaz banao aur L06 ke silent videos pe
CapCut mein lagao.
Honest limitation
Teeno clips mein awaaz thodi alag lag sakti hai — sun ke check karo, alag lage toh wahi clip
dobara.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni reel pe Hindi awaaz daalo.

records.heading: Lesson 08 — Kahan Aur Kab Post Karein
records.content:
•Teen jagah: Instagram (caption + local hashtags), WhatsApp (status + sirf saved number
walon ko broadcast), Google Business Profile (offer post, photos ka order, review replies).
•Weekly plan: din, platform, time — customers ke time ke hisaab se. Daily 15 minute ki
checklist.
•chat G.P.T ne Google Business ke liye dusre cafes ki example photos dikhayi aur khud likha
"Upload real photos" — hamesha apni asli photos.
Honest limitation
Posting time sirf andaaza hai, data nahi. 2–3 hafte baad dekho kya chala aur badlo. Nakli
review ya khareede followers kabhi nahi.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni dukaan ka hafte ka post plan banao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 08 — Kahan Aur Kab Post Karein

records.heading: Lesson 09 — Ye Kaam Service Ki Tarah
records.content:
•chat G.P.T se 3 packages (Basic, Standard, Plus): kya milega + kitne ghante lagenge.
Daam ki jagah [price] — apne shehar ke hisaab se khud tay karo.
•Pehla WhatsApp message: chhota, ek free sample poster ka offer, aur "interested nahi ho
toh koi baat nahi".
•Kaam se pehle client se sawaal: details, asli photos, approved offers/daam, tyohaar,
platforms, approval kaun dega.
•"Main kaise kaam karta hoon" note: asli photos, asli daam, har post maalik ki manzoori se,
content ka maalik client, ek round changes.
Honest limitation
Sample bhejo toh saaf batao ki demo hai. "Bikri dugni" jaise waade kabhi nahi.
Aaj ka kaam
Paas ki ek dukaan ke liye sample banao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 09 — Ye Kaam Service Ki Tarah

records.heading: Lesson 10 — Finale: Galtiyan, Niyam, Final Project
records.content:
•Recap: brief → photos → food → posters → video → awaaz → posting plan → service.
•Top 3 galtiyan: (1) adhoora prompt (jhoomar, dhaniya), (2) bina padhe post karna
(MAFENU, check date), (3) AI ko khud offer banane dena (Buy 1 Get 1).
•Teen niyam: asli photo, asli daam, har post maalik ki manzoori se.
•Saare prompts notes section mein hain.
Aaj ka kaam
Final project: ek asli dukaan (maalik se poochh ke) ka poora set — brief, 2 photo upgrade, 1
food/product photo, 1 offer poster, 1 awaaz wali reel, hafte ka plan — aur maalik ko dikhao.
records.lessonName: Lesson 10 — Finale: Galtiyan, Niyam, Final Project

records.heading: Tutor instructions and honest advertising
records.content:
• Jawab Hinglish mein, dost jaisa, chhota aur seedha. Zaroorat ho toh steps numbered do.
• Jahan kaam ka lesson hai, uska number batao (jaise "yeh Lesson 05 mein hai").
• Prompt maange toh course ka exact prompt do (Part F), [brackets] mein user ki dukaan ki
details daal ke.
• Tools ki price, plan, credits ya feature limits ke pakke number mat batao — ye badalte
rehte hain.
• Kamai ka koi promise ya number mat do. Service ke daam user apne shehar ke hisaab se
khud tay kare — course mein daam ki jagah [price] hai.
• Nakli review, khareede followers, jhoothe offers/daam, ya dukaan ko asli se alag dikhana —
iski help mat karo. Imaandari wala tareeka batao.
•  Kisi aur dukaan ki photo ya brand ka logo use karne ki help mat karo — hamesha client ki
asli photos.
• Course ke tools: chat G.P.T, Google Flow, CapCut, ElevenLabs (optional). Bahar ke tools
course ka part nahi.
• Pata na ho toh saaf bolo, guess mat karo.

records.heading: Course glossary
records.content:
Term              Matlab

Business Brief       Dukaan ki details, customer types, ad angles, offers aur 30 din ka plan — ek page
mein. Har lesson ka base.

Ad angle            Ek customer type + usko kya chahiye, uske hisaab se ad ki baat.

Re-shoot prompt      Purani photo sirf reference; AI ko kehna dish/dukaan naye sire se professional shoot
kare — par cheezein wahi rahein.

Ingredients           Flow Video mode mein photo(s) daalne ki jagah.

Voiceover             Off-screen awaaz jo video ke upar bolti hai — screen pe koi nahi bolta.

Aspect ratio           1:1 = square post, 9:16 = status/reel, 16:9 = landscape. Photo upgrade mein ratio
photo jaisa hi rakho.

(check date)          chat G.P.T ko kaha tha har tyohaar pe ye likhe, taaki tareekh calendar se verify ho.

[price]           Daam ki jagah placeholder — daam hamesha dukaan ka maalik tay karta hai.

records.heading: Lesson 02 — Step 1: Details → customers, time, ad angles
records.content:
I run a small [cafe / salon / bakery / shop] in [area, city]. Details:
- Menu / services: [list]
- Price range: [₹ – ₹]
- Timing: [opening – closing]
- Seating / size: [if any]
- Who usually comes: [students, office people, families...]
- What's special: [only write what is true]
Make a simple business brief:
1. Types of customers and what time of day they come
2. What each type cares about most
3. One ad angle for each type
Keep it short, in simple Hinglish.
records.lessonName: Lesson 02 — Step 1: Details → customers, time, ad angles
aliases: Step 1: Details → customers, time, ad angles

records.heading: Lesson 02 — Step 2: 5 offers
records.content:
Suggest 5 offer ideas for this [shop] that are simple and won't hurt profit much — like
combos, a happy hour, or a student deal. For each one, say who it is for and the best day
or time to run it. Don't decide prices — write [price] wherever the owner should fill it
in.

records.heading: Lesson 02 — Step 3: 30 din ka post plan
records.content:
Make a 30-day post plan for this [shop] starting [date]. For each week, tell me what to
post on Instagram and WhatsApp status — a food/product photo, an offer poster, a short
reel, or a behind-the-counter moment. Include any Indian festivals in these dates and mark
them clearly with "(check date)" so I can verify them.
records.lessonName: Lesson 02 — Step 3: 30 din ka post plan

records.heading: Lesson 02 — Step 4: Ek page ka Business Brief
records.content:
Now put everything into one short Business Brief I can save and reuse: business details,
customer types, 3 ad angles, 5 offers, and the 30-day plan. Clean headings, no extra text.
records.lessonName: Lesson 02 — Step 4: Ek page ka Business Brief
aliases: Step 4: Ek page ka Business Brief

records.heading: Lesson 03 — Andar ki photo upgrade
records.content:
Turn this phone photo of my [shop] into a professional interior photograph, like one shot
by a good photographer for Instagram and Google Maps. Keep the same room, same furniture,
same counter, same boards and same layout — do not add or remove any furniture.
Make these improvements boldly:
- Lighting: replace the harsh tube-light look with warm, soft, inviting light
- Colours: rich and warm, clean walls, natural shine on surfaces
- Camera: straighten the photo, fix the tilt and the stretched wide-angle look, frame it
at normal eye level
- Clean-up: tables wiped clean, chairs neatly pushed in, floor clean, remove clutter,
wires and stains
- Quality: sharp focus, no grain, natural depth, looks like a real DSLR photo
No people, no new decorations, no plants, no text added. Realistic, not AI-looking.

records.heading: Lesson 03 — Shop front, shaam ka look
records.content:
Turn this phone photo of my [shop]'s front into a professional evening photograph. Keep
the same building, same door, same chairs outside and the same signboard — the text "[SHOP
NAME]" must stay exactly the same, do not change, re-write or translate it.
Make these improvements boldly:
- Time: early evening, soft deep-blue sky, warm golden light glowing from inside
- Camera: straighten the photo, fix the tilt, frame the shop front centred and balanced
- Clean-up: remove parked vehicles, wrappers and dust, tidy the overhead wires, clean
footpath
- Colours: rich and warm, sharp focus, no grain, looks like a real DSLR photo
No people, no new signs, no new lights or decorations added. Realistic, not AI-looking.
records.lessonName: Lesson 03 — Shop front, shaam ka look

records.heading: Lesson 03 — WhatsApp status version (9:16)
records.content:
Use this [shop] photo. Make a vertical 9:16 version of the same [shop] for WhatsApp status
— same interior, same furniture, nothing new added. Keep clean empty space in the top
third (a plain warm wall or soft blur) so text can be added later. Do not write any text.

records.heading: Lesson 04 — Dish re-shoot
records.content:
Use this phone photo only as a reference for what our dish looks like. Now re-shoot this
same dish from scratch as a professional food photographer would, for our menu and
Instagram.
The dish: [describe it exactly — e.g. one normal single portion of masala Maggi on a round
steel plate with a steel fork] — exactly the ingredients you see in the reference, nothing
extra.
The new shot:
- Freshly plated, hot and glossy, with light natural steam rising
- Soft warm window light from the left, gentle shadows, rich appetising colours
- 45-degree food angle, close-up, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the food
- Set on a clean warm wooden table, softly blurred cosy background
Do NOT add cheese, vegetables, coriander, egg or any garnish that is not in the reference.
Same portion size, not bigger. No text, no people. Must look like a real DSLR food photo,
not AI.
placeholders:
[describe it exactly — e.g. one normal single portion of masala Maggi on a round
steel plate with a steel fork]

records.heading: Lesson 04 — Drink re-shoot
records.content:
Use this phone photo only as a reference for what our drink looks like. Now re-shoot this
same drink from scratch as a professional drink photographer would, for our menu and
Instagram.
The drink: [describe it exactly — e.g. one tall plain glass of cold coffee with a little
foam on top and a straw] — exactly as in the reference, nothing extra.
The new shot:
- Freshly poured, rich colour, light cold condensation drops on the glass
- Soft bright light from behind and the side so the glass glows
- Straight-on eye-level angle, close-up, shallow depth of field
- Set on a clean warm wooden table, softly blurred cosy background
Do NOT add ice cream, whipped cream, syrup, ice on top or any garnish that is not in the
reference. Same glass size, same amount. No text, no people. Must look like a real DSLR
drink photo, not AI.
placeholders:
[describe it exactly — e.g. one tall plain glass of cold coffee with a little
foam on top and a straw]

records.heading: Lesson 04 — Combo photo (dono results upload karke)
records.content:
Use these two photos as reference for the dishes. Re-shoot them together as one
professional "[combo name]" photo: this same [item 1] and this same [item 2] placed side
by side on one clean warm wooden table. Same portions, nothing extra added. Soft warm
window light, 45-degree angle, both sharp, softly blurred background. Leave clean empty
space at the top for text later. Do not write any text. Real DSLR photo, not AI.
records.lessonName: Lesson 04 — Combo photo (dono results upload karke)

records.heading: Lesson 05 — Offer poster
records.content:
Use this photo of our [items] as the main image. Turn it into a clean, modern offer poster
for Instagram for our [shop]. Keep the food exactly as it is in the photo — do not add or
change anything on the plate or in the glass.
Write ONLY this text, spelled exactly like this, nothing else:
- Top, big bold: "[OFFER NAME]"
- Below it: "[item 1] + [item 2]"
- Big price badge: "₹[price]"
- Small: "[days, time]"
- Bottom: "[SHOP NAME] · [area, city]"
Warm colours, easy-to-read bold fonts, clean layout with the food clearly visible. Do not
add any other words, discounts, percentages, logos or claims.

records.heading: Lesson 05 — Tyohaar greeting poster
records.content:
Use this photo of our shop front as the main image. Make a warm [festival] greeting
poster. Keep the shop, the building and the "[SHOP NAME]" signboard exactly the same — do
not change the shop itself.
Add festive feeling only as a decorative design around the photo: a soft glowing frame of
[diyas / lights / festival elements] along the edges, gentle golden sparkles. Do not place
decorations on the real shop.
Write ONLY this text, spelled exactly like this:
- Top: "[Happy Diwali]"
- Bottom: "Warm wishes from [SHOP NAME]"
Elegant, easy-to-read fonts. No offers, no prices, no other words.

records.heading: Lesson 06 — Shop front push-in
records.content:
Use this photo of our shop front as the exact reference. Make a 6-second vertical video:
the camera slowly pushes forward toward the glowing door, smooth and steady, like a calm
evening walk-up. Warm light glows from inside, a gentle breeze, the evening sky slowly
darkens a little. Keep the building, the shutter, the chairs and the "[SHOP NAME]"
signboard exactly the same — the text on the board must not change. Do not add people,
cars, new signs, decorations or lights. Ambient street sound only, no music, no voices, no
text on screen.

records.heading: Lesson 06 — Andar glide
records.content:
Use this photo of our [shop] interior as the exact reference. Make a 6-second vertical
video: the camera slowly glides forward into the [shop] at eye level, as if a customer is
walking in, moving gently toward the counter. Soft warm light, a little steam rising from
the [chai urn / coffee machine]. Keep the same tables, chairs, counter, boards and walls
exactly as in the photo. Do not add people, new furniture, plants, decorations or any
objects that are not in the photo. Soft ambient sound only, no music, no voices, no text
on screen.

records.heading: Lesson 06 — Food close-up
records.content:
Use this photo of our [dish] as the exact reference. Make a 6-second vertical close-up
video: the camera slowly circles a little around the plate, warm natural steam rising,
soft window light. Keep the same plate and the same portion — do not add any other food or
garnish. No hands, no people. Gentle ambient sound only, no music, no voices, no text on
screen.

records.heading: Lesson 07 — Step 1: 3 lines (chat G.P.T)
records.content:
I'm making a 24-second Instagram reel for my [shop] [SHOP NAME] in [area, city]. It has 3
clips of 8 seconds each:
1) the shop front
2) inside the [shop]
3) a close-up of our [best item]
Write one short Hindi voiceover line for each clip, in Devanagari script.
Rules:
- Each line must be easy to say in 6 seconds — maximum 12 words
- Friendly and natural, like talking to a friend
- No claims like "best", "No.1", "sabse sasta" or "famous"
- Use only these facts: [menu, offer with price and timing, opening hours]
placeholders: [menu, offer with price and timing, opening hours]

records.heading: Lesson 07 — Step 2: Awaaz wali clip (Flow · Video · 8 sec · 9:16) — har clip ke liye line badlo
records.content:
Use this photo of our [shop front / interior / dish] as the exact reference. Make an
8-second vertical video: [one slow camera move — push toward the door / glide inside /
circle the plate]. Keep everything exactly as in the photo — the "[SHOP NAME]" signboard
text must not change. No people on screen.
Voiceover: a warm, friendly young Indian [male / female] narrator, off-screen, speaking
clear natural Hindi at a relaxed pace. Nobody on screen speaks.
TIMING: 0–1s: ambient sound only. 1–7s: the narrator says: "[LINE from chat G.P.T, in
Devanagari]" 7–8s: ambient sound only.
Soft ambient sound under the voice, no music, no text on screen.

records.heading: Lesson 08 — Instagram caption + hashtags
records.content:
Write an Instagram caption for our 24-second reel (shop front → inside → [best item]
close-up). Keep it short and friendly in Hinglish. Mention [area, city] and [offer with
price and timing]. Add 8–10 hashtags — mostly local ones ([city], [area], [type of shop])
and a few [food / service] ones. No claims like "best" or "No.1".

records.heading: Lesson 08 — WhatsApp status + broadcast
records.content:
Now write for WhatsApp:
1) 3 short status lines for this week — one for the reel, one for the offer poster, one
for the festival greeting. Max 10 words each.
2) One short broadcast message for regular customers who have saved our number — friendly,
no pressure, with our timing [opening – closing].
No fake urgency like "only today" or "last chance" unless it is true.

records.heading: Lesson 08 — Google Business Profile
records.content:
Now help with our Google Business Profile:
1) A short "Offer" post for [offer] (max 50 words)
2) Which photos to upload (shop front, inside, food/products) and in what order
3) A polite reply template for a good review, and one for a bad review
Don't write any reviews for us — only the replies.

records.heading: Lesson 08 — Hafte ka posting plan
records.content:
Make a simple weekly posting plan as a table: Day | Instagram | WhatsApp Status | Google
Business. Use the customer timings from our brief to suggest a posting time for each. Keep
it simple enough for one person to manage in about 15 minutes a day.

records.heading: Lesson 09 — 3 packages
records.content:
I want to offer AI-made marketing content as a service to small local shops in my area —
cafes, salons, bakeries, kirana stores. I only use ChatGPT, Google Flow and CapCut.
Suggest 3 simple monthly packages: Basic, Standard and Plus. For each, list exactly what
the shop gets (for example: number of photo upgrades, offer posters, festival posters,
reels, Google Business posts per month) and roughly how many hours it takes me.
Don't suggest any prices — write [price] where I should fill it in. No promises about
sales, followers or results.

records.heading: Lesson 09 — Pehla WhatsApp message
records.content:
Write a short, polite first WhatsApp message in simple Hinglish that I can send to a local
shop owner I know or have visited. In one line say what I do, offer to make one free
sample poster from a photo of their shop, and say clearly that it's completely okay if
they're not interested. No promises about sales or followers. Maximum 60 words.

records.heading: Lesson 09 — Client se sawaal
records.content:
Make a simple checklist of questions I should ask a shop owner before starting work:
business details, what real photos they can give me, which offers and prices they approve,
festivals they celebrate, which platforms they use, and who will approve posts. Keep it as
a short list I can send on WhatsApp.

records.heading: Lesson 09 — "Main kaise kaam karta hoon" note
records.content:
Write a short "how I work" note I can share with every client, in simple Hinglish: I only
use their real photos and their real prices, every poster and caption is sent to them for
approval before posting, they own all the content I make for them, and how changes work.
Maximum 120 words.
